title: A push that changes only the ledger runs ci and republishes an unchanged build
foundBy: user report (host): "support ledger builds on pushes that only contain ledger changes, with just linting, ledger checking, and a pages build to publish the ledger page"

evidence.verified: The push of cefc630, which changed only `ledger/`, ran two workflows: `ledger` on the push and `pages` after it, both green. No `ci`, `npm` or `publish images` run exists for that commit, and no npm version or image was published for it. The status file that `pages` wrote still lists 5ffce63 first in `built`.

resolution: `ci` ignores a push whose every change is under `ledger/`. The `ledger` workflow checks such a push with the ledger check and the document linters, and the site republishes when it finishes.
details: Closing an issue is a commit that changes only `ledger/`, and pushing it runs the whole of `ci`. `ci` finishing then publishes a build of code that has not changed: its npm packages and their images. Such a push needs only the ledger check, the document linters and a site build, which publishes the ledger's page.
